source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Chromatography, printed as a second 15.3 on pages 329-330.

blocks.text: Chromatography aisa tareeqa hai jo zyada tar mixture ke sample ko alag karne ke liye istemal hota hai. Is mein solute (mixture) do phases ke darmiyan bant jata hai (distribute hota hai): stationary phase aur mobile phase.

blocks.title: Stationary phase aur mobile phase
blocks.text: Stationary phase (thehri hui phase) solid ho sakti hai, ya aisa liquid jo kisi inert (react na karne wale) solid ki satah par patli tah (thin film) ki shakal mein ho. Mobile phase (chalne wali phase) stationary phase ki satah par behti hai; yeh gas ya liquid ho sakti hai.

blocks.title: Adsorption chromatography
blocks.text: Jis chromatography mein stationary phase solid ho, use adsorption chromatography kehte hain.
Is qism mein madda mobile phase ko chhor kar solid phase ki satah par chipak jata hai (adsorb hota hai). Misalen: thin layer chromatography (TLC) aur column chromatography.

blocks.title: Partition chromatography
blocks.text: Jis chromatography mein stationary phase liquid ho, use partition chromatography kehte hain.
Is qism mein alag hone wale madde stationary aur mobile dono phases mein bant jate hain. Misalen: paper chromatography aur gas liquid chromatography.

blocks.prompt: Adsorption aur partition chromatography mein farq batayein. Kisi dastawez (document) ki syahi (ink) chromatography se kyun jaanchi jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Adsorption mein stationary phase solid hai aur components is liye alag hote hain ke woh us ki satah se kam ya zyada chipakte hain. Partition mein stationary phase liquid hai aur components dono phases mein mukhtalif tarah bant kar alag hote hain. Syahi rangon ka mixture hai; har syahi apne spots aur Rf values ka khaas pattern deti hai, is liye chromatography dikha deti hai ke dastawez ke do hisse ek hi syahi se likhe gaye ya nahi.

items: Chromatography: solute stationary phase (solid, ya solid par liquid ki tah) aur mobile phase (gas ya liquid) mein bant-ta hai.
Adsorption (stationary solid: TLC, column); partition (stationary liquid: paper, gas liquid).
